analysis.event: Taiwan reported the highest number of mpox cases in October in two years, with 18 cases, 16 of which were Clade 1b. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) confirmed these cases and noted that all 16 Clade 1b cases involved unprotected sexual contact (N1, N2, N4, N7).
